_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: For everything there is a season.
And a time for every matter under heaven.
See, God is making all things new.
The old has gone; behold, the new.
Whatever you did for the least of these, you did for me.
Send us to the ones you love.
Come, let us worship at the turning of the year.
Thanks be to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: A year has worn down to its last hour, and you carry into this room all of it — the planting and the uprooting, the weeping and the laughing.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
Hear the One on the throne say it over your tired year: See, I am making all things new — and he wipes the tears from your face.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
He points us back out the door, toward the hungry and the stranger and the prisoner: whatever you did for them, you did for me.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
So step into the new year unafraid; the Alpha and the Omega holds both ends of your days.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Thanks be to God!
